title: Putin backs Trump's push for Ukraine ceasefire in principle, but says "there are issues" to discuss with U.S.
description: Russia's Vladimir Putin said he agrees in principle with a U.S. proposal for a 30-day ceasefire in Ukraine, but that the terms need to be worked out.

title: Russia sticks to red lines on 30-day Ukraine ceasefire plan - as Zelenskyy attacks 'manipulative' Putin
description: The Russian president thanked Donald Trump for "paying so much attention to regulating the conflict in Ukraine" and said he needs to speak with his American counterpart.

title: Putin's definite 'maybe' on ceasefire with Ukraine keeps the White House engaged
description: Russia’s president appeared to hedge his bets on the issue of a Ukrainian ceasefire, saying it was a good idea but refusing to implement it, for now. That keeps the dialogue open with Donald Trump, but it means the war continues.

title: Trump Sees ‘Good Signals’ on Russia-Ukraine Cease-Fire. Zelensky Does Not.
description: U.S. officials were in Moscow for talks, and the Russian leader said he was open to a cease-fire, but President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine expressed skepticism.

title: Putin rejects immediate ceasefire in Ukraine
description: Vladimir Putin said Russia supports the proposal but it does not address the root causes. Follow live updates.

title: Ukraine loses a ceasefire bargaining chip as its troops cede ground in Russia
description: KYIV, Ukraine (AP) — As momentum builds for a ceasefire with Russia, Ukraine has all but lost a valuable bargaining chip.

title: Putin says he supports ceasefire with Ukraine but may need to call Trump
description: Russia sees the ceasefire suggested by the U.S. and Ukraine as little more than a chance for Kyiv's forces to regroup, a senior aide to Vladimir Putin said.

title: Can the US pry Russia away from China?
description: Western politicians have repeatedly called on China to limit or cease tacit support for Russia’s bloody war against Ukraine

title: Trump Says Ukraine's Land, Power Plant Discussed in Ceasefire Talks
description: Trump said his administration has discussed key details with Ukraine regarding a final peace deal to end its war against Russia.

title: Kremlin told U.S. it didn't want Trump's Ukraine-Russia envoy at peace talks
description: President Donald Trump’s special envoy for Ukraine and Russia was excluded from high-level talks on ending the war after the Kremlin said it didn't want him there, a U.S. administration official and a Russian official told NBC News.
